_comment: Explicit download sources for content that is NOT on Modrinth.
update_manifest.py resolves every file by sha512 against Modrinth first; anything
that misses is looked up here. A miss with no entry is a hard error -- the tool will
not emit a manifest with a file it cannot tell friends how to download.
Keys for mods are the fabric.mod.json 'id'. Keys for anything else are the filename.
{version} and {filename} are substituted from the jar itself, so a version bump
